title: Lift prime-field recovery certificates to extension-field algebras (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A prime-field recovery certificate can now be converted explicitly into an extension-field multiplication table and factor maps. Claim type: scoped constructive proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

For every finite-degree field extension K/F and K-bilinear square tensor t, general commutative unital multiplication recognition is preserved by restriction to F. Given any F-certificate `t(Pa,Qb)=S(ab)` and its recovered unit e:

```text
u=P e; v=Q e
R_v(x)=t(x,v); L_u(y)=t(u,y)
mu(x,y)=t(R_v^-1 x,L_u^-1 y)
return K-table(mu), unit=t(u,v), maps (R_v^-1,L_u^-1,I)
```

The two slices are invertible K-linear maps even when P,Q,S are not K-linear. The written proof and bounded adapter are in `research/commutative-scalar-ascent`.

aliromman's #5540 supplies the prime-field recovery interface and extension-field question. #5637 already implements a direct recognizer for the local characteristic-power truncated-polynomial class. Older #6464 already proves general recognition over a supplied exact field; its cyclic-module construction is not used here. This contribution is the explicit scalar-restriction certificate bridge. Restriction of scalars and unital isotope normalization are classical. Credit aliromman, apoursh, Nick Petalas, Dugongue and the retained tensor/algebra lineage. No predecessor executable or scientific suite is imported or replayed.

## Evidence

Before, the existing prime-field certificate interface supplied no scalar-restriction adapter. After, the standalone adapter returns a checked K-table and K-linear isotopy, including products, non-Gorenstein algebras, nonsplit residue fields and nilpotent extensions of nonsplit fields.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 passes:

- 78 newly constructed certificates over F4, F8, F9 and F25, 684 K-basis products and 75 recovery bases that are not K-linear. The largest restricted dimension is 12.
- All 16,930 field-law triples in those four arithmetic domains, ten rejecting controls and two boundary witnesses. The latter explain why K-bilinearity and a general commutative recognizer are required.
- Both warning-strict normal/optimized registered commands, generated source-hash receipts, metadata/provenance and eight-file committed-byte/mode/source-history checks. Each registered command was timed locally below one second against its 120-second limit.
- Official export integrity and input-coverage checks, followed by normal and optimized Git-free replay with empty PATH from a read-only export. Reports agree and all nine exported files retain their hashes.

Exact reproduction from the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/commutative-scalar-ascent/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/commutative-scalar-ascent/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/commutative-scalar-ascent
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/commutative-scalar-ascent --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace that absolute interpreter path. Expected markers are `PASS_COMMUTATIVE_SCALAR_ASCENT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

Canonical base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8, selected #7000. The `formal-interface-lemma` card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side result. The selected metadata orientation passed. Live claims, full cached open-PR bodies, merged searches and all-main README searches were checked; sparse local-note and unpublished-work coverage remains limited. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19572847).

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim rests on the written proof. The executable consumes supplied certificates in explicitly supported polynomial fields with q at most 25 and restricted dimension at most 12. It is not an end-to-end recognizer integration, a prescribed algebra-class classifier or a special-linear label transfer. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

No native coefficient implementation, paid caller, dirty restoration program, physical precision/tape proof, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run is supplied. All five selected assumptions remain. No required local package check is deferred solely to CI.

## Open next questions

- Connect one actual source-owned prime-field recovery output to this adapter with a general exact finite-field interface and explicit coordinate basis.
- Recover one prescribed algebra-class or determinant label using the restricted algebra together with its embedded scalar action.
- Specify and price a native caller for one recovered table, including coefficient maps, workspace, returns and restoration.

## Related open work

- [#7252](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7252) computes stabilizer determinant images for split radical-square-zero multiplication tensors. This adapter constructs general K-linear recovery certificates and computes no determinant image or orbit count.
- [#7270](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7270) encodes automorphisms of local Frobenius-truncated algebras. This adapter supplies a general recovered table and isotopy; it supplies no automorphism encoding or shared numerical optimum.

The completion refresh inspected all seven other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM: #7469, #7470, #7471, #7472, #7474, #7476 and #7477. Their one-step threshold, integral biclique, rounded-lattice, partition, rounded-shear, factor-gauge and tape-retirement objects do not study commutative-tensor scalar ascent. No new related line or competing numerical value was identified, and no additional mathematical computation checked those results.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `8cfb0297ed41284b17cfcfe3e8eef9c335929b91`, [run 43290306518](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43290306518), [plan job 131434472137](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43290306518/job/131434472137), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. I read the checks once and downloaded the job log. Exactly one of 760 tests failed, with 24 skipped:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
FAILED (failures=1, skipped=24)
```

At base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify` and omits the selected command. I checked both base files directly. This PR changes neither file. The package `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed, so hosted execution covered no package checks.

I also downloaded and checked the plan logs for [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), job 130140894651, and [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), job 130134720799. Each has the same sole failing test, missing-command assertion and `760 tests / 1 failure / 24 skipped` summary. No fix, retrigger commit or job rerun was made. The maintainers retain the repository-level repair.

All local checks recorded above passed at the same head. Hosted replay, independent human review and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Eight new files in one opt-in package. Shared code, frozen sources and the selected record are unchanged.
